title: RAW update-252..264 phase-trace A/RECON
context: Claim: On the unchanged B01 finite panel and exact seed-0 RAW trajectory, updates 252 through 264 provide a bounded measurement of local checkpoint-phase sensitivity around the comparator-weak update-256 observation. Binding structure: systems / information flow; the RAW gate acts on a four-agent common-history packet under partial observability, while this A/RECON isolates learner-order exposure and makes no residual-information claim.

options.label: launch as carded
options.consequence: Freeze the exact RAW-only card and continue through the bounded CM chain without waiting.

options.label: do not launch
options.consequence: Stop before launch and return the unchanged BR-E boundary to Root.

options.label: revise before launch
options.consequence: Apply the owner's prospective revision before any later launch; prior B01 remains unchanged.

packet.question: 是否接受并继续执行 CRTO 的 RAW-only 更新 252..264 A/RECON 卡片？

changes_if_approved.from: 下一步只有已选择但未冻结、未实现的 RAW checkpoint trace
changes_if_approved.to: 冻结为单一路径、13 个预先声明 checkpoint、无残差效应结论的 A/RECON，并进入有界 CM 链

packet.if_refused: 不启动、不实现该 trace；B01 仍保持 BR-E / COMPARATOR_WEAK，方向与 Portfolio 状态均不改变，并在干净边界返回 Root。

evidence_for.quote: The cheapest next discriminator is a separate RAW-only A/RECON trace on the same exact population, initialization, order, and batch size, with every checkpoint `252..264` declared before the run.
evidence_for.why: 已接受结果明确指出该 trace 是最小的下一判别器。

evidence_for.quote: It separates checkpoint phase from inadequate RAW exposure/model capacity before another three-path comparison is paid for or interpreted.
evidence_for.why: 先定位 RAW 路径可避免在比较器尚未胜任时扩大三臂实验。

evidence_against.quote: RAW-LONG passed the KEEP condition with `8/8` exact and zero mean regret. It failed the REPLAN condition in both ways: `4/8` exact is below the required `6/8`, and mean regret `0.0066464624` is above `0.005`.
evidence_against.why: 当前比较器确实较弱；此卡只能测量局部路径，不能把某个暴露后的 checkpoint 事后升级为胜任基线。

uncertainty: wsl_4070 CPU 是否重现本地 B01 的 update-256 锚点；若不重现则该尝试不完整且无科学极性。
即使局部相位波动明显，单 seed、结果知情面板仍不能支持稳定算法效应。

cost.compute: 单 RAW 臂预计 1304.1200061 秒，硬上限 1800 秒；一次 remote-first 调用。
cost.owner_time: 约 2 分钟审阅卡片与边界。

packet.verdict_text: Recommendation: (a). It is the smallest runnable object because it reuses the accepted B01 population and learner primitives, observes only the missing thirteen checkpoints, and preserves the exact comparator meaning.
